prices = {"りんご": 120, "パン": 200, "牛乳": 180}
cart = [("りんご", 3), ("パン", 1), ("牛乳", 2)]

def line_total(item, count):
    return prices[item] * count

subtotal = 0
for item, count in cart:
    t = line_total(item, count)
    print(f"{item} x{count} = {t}円")
    subtotal += t

if subtotal >= 1000:
    discount = subtotal // 10
else:
    discount = 0

tax = (subtotal - discount) * 8 // 100
total = subtotal - discount + tax
print("小計:", subtotal)
print("割引:", discount)
print("合計:", total)
